title: Grade 2 Math — Mon, May 25
description: 2D Shapes — Day 1 of 5: Identifying basic shapes
subject: mathematics

questions.question: How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 sides. Tri means three!

questions.question: Which shape has 4 equal sides?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 corners. All sides are the same length.

questions.question: A circle has how many sides?
questions.explanation: A circle has no sides and no corners. It is a perfectly round shape.

questions.question: How many corners does a square have?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 corners (also called vertices). One at each angle.

questions.question: Which shape looks like a door?
questions.explanation: A rectangle looks like a door — it has 4 sides but opposite sides are equal. It is longer than it is wide.

questions.question: How many sides does a rectangle have?
questions.explanation: A rectangle has 4 sides. The top and bottom are equal, and the left and right sides are equal.

questions.question: Which shape is like a pizza slice?
questions.explanation: A pizza slice is shaped like a triangle — it has 3 sides and comes to a point!

questions.question: How many corners does a triangle have?
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 corners (vertices). The number of corners always equals the number of sides!

questions.question: A wheel is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A wheel is shaped like a circle — round with no sides or corners.

questions.question: Which shape has 5 sides?
questions.explanation: A pentagon has 5 sides. Penta means five in Greek!

questions.question: How many sides does a hexagon have?
questions.explanation: A hexagon has 6 sides. Hexa means six. A honeycomb is made of hexagons!

questions.question: A book cover is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A book cover is a rectangle — 4 sides, longer than it is wide.

questions.question: Which shape has NO corners?
questions.explanation: A circle has no corners at all! It is completely round.

questions.question: How many sides does a square have?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 sides — all the same length!

questions.question: A stop sign has 8 sides. What shape is it?
questions.explanation: An octagon has 8 sides. Octo means eight. A stop sign is an octagon!
